selector.rationale: Ocular syphilis best explains the combination of ocular and systemic findings, including the positive cerebrospinal fluid T pallidum particle agglutination assay and the presence of spirochetes in skin lesion histopathology

rejected.label: HIV-related immunosuppression
rejected.why: while HIV-related immunosuppression is present, it does not directly explain the specific ocular findings

rejected.label: HIV-related Retinitis
rejected.why: HIV-related retinitis is not supported by the presence of spirochetes in skin lesion histopathology and the positive cerebrospinal fluid T pallidum particle agglutination assay

rejected.label: Syphilitic retinitis
rejected.why: while syphilitic retinitis is a possible diagnosis, ocular syphilis is a more comprehensive diagnosis that explains the range of ocular and systemic findings
